spans.s:
ख्या ख्या, cl. 2. P. and in the non-con-
jugational tenses P. A. ख्याति, चख्यौ,
चख्ये, ख्यास्यति, -ते, अख्यत्, अख्यत, ख्या-
तुम्, (the original meaning of this root seems to have
been ‘to perceive, look, view, see,’ and it has this
sense in the Veda when combined with prepositions;
the simple verb occurs only in Pass. and Caus.):
Pass. ख्यायते, to be known, be named: Caus.
[]
ख्यापयति, -यितुम्, to make known, promulgate,
proclaim; to relate, tell, say, declare, betray, de-
nounce; to make well known or renowned, to praise:
Desid. चिख्यासति, -ते: Intens. चाख्यायते, चाख्-
याति and चाख्येति; [cf. Lat. in-quam, &c.]

ख्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, known, named, called, deno-
nominated: told; well known, celebrated, notorious,
famous.
—ख्यात-गर्हण or ख्यात-गर्हित, अस्,
आ, अम्, having a bad name or evil report; notoriously
vile, infamous.

ख्यातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be styled or called or
denominated; to be told; to be celebrated.

ख्याति, इस्, f. the being well known, renown,
fame, glory, celebrity; a name, denomination, title;
fame personified as a daughter of Dakṣa or as a
daughter of Kardama and wife of Bhṛgu; the means
of individual fruition, or the faculty of discriminating
objects by appropriate designations and the like,
opinion, knowledge; (इस्), m., N. of a son of the
fourth Manu.
—ख्याति-कर or ख्याति-जनक, अस्,
आ, अम्, causing renown, glorious.
—ख्याति-घ्न, अस्,
ई, अम्, destroying reputation, disgraceful.
—ख्याति-
बोध, अस्, m. sense of honour.
—ख्याति-मत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, renowned.
ख्याप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be told or related.
